Gunslingers.name: Gunslingers
Gunslingers.summary: Professor Molina's train, the SteamBane, is rocketing through the canyons. The world's most powerful explosive is bolted to the engine. Only the four quickest guns in the West can stop them.

Rock Band 3.name: Rock Band 3
Rock Band 3.summary: Rock Band 3 adds 83 new songs to the Rock Band library and for the first time supports a keyboard/keytar peripheral.
